decision: Retain resistor-programmed charger for this prototype; do not migrate to BQ25186 I2C interface. Preserve all user capacity/runtime/size requirements.
screen_limits: Current screen combines published >=40mA accuracy with resistor tolerance; does not prove transient performance
Termination tolerance at this low setting is not established by the cited 3mA table condition
4.1V and early termination may reduce available capacity; no capacity percentage is asserted
Charge time must include precharge, CV, thermal/input limiting and timer behavior; C/I alone is insufficient
reason_not_bq25186: Watchdog restores all writable defaults, including nominal 4.2V and 500mA input setting
Requires I2C pins and reset-safe charge inhibition or voltage guard; no verified board-area saving
Existing BQ25185 fixed 4.1V setting avoids dependence on persistent voltage-register contents
required_remaining: Complete independent battery-contact temperature sensing and hardware charge-inhibit qualification; R35 fixed TS resistor alone does not monitor battery temperature
Verify external USB pre-enumeration limiter and suspend controls; internal 500mA mode alone is insufficient
Measure deliverable energy after this exact charge profile and run continuous 16h recording test
Confirm maximum battery discharge, regulator/storage peak current and undervoltage behavior
Complete power routing, BOM sourcing and enclosure contact sensor retention
